title: DAILY FIGHTER — WEEK 1 DAY 1
emphasis: Foundation: lower-stress planche technique, ring support, posterior-chain durability, spinal-engine control, and elastic mechanics

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min mobility. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1/C×1/E×1 (20:15), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Curved-Treadmill Intervals
ignition.home: Curved treadmill: 15-sec smooth pickup + 45-sec easy walk ×10
ignition.away: Outdoor run-walk with the same timing

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: PLANCHE TECHNIQUE
deposits.effort: Current rung: shallow pseudo-planche push-up. Last: 3×4 on 2026-09-08 at RPE 7. Rest 1:15; repeat shape and reps. Gate: 3×6–8 twice at ≤RPE 8.

exercises.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
exercises.home: Floor or parallettes: 4 shallow pseudo-planche push-ups
exercises.cue: Protract; locked body; stop before shape breaks

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: ANTI-ROTATION PULL + RING SUPPORT
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00 between rounds; RPE 7. Ring-support gate is earned only after today is verified completed pain-free.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Standing Row Single Arm
exercises.home: Dopa Band: 8 single-arm standing rows / SIDE
exercises.cue: Square ribs and hips; do not rotate

exercises.name: Ring Support Hold
exercises.cue: Push tall; rings quiet; ribs down

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: POSTERIOR CHAIN + SPINAL ENGINE
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45 between rounds; 4 RIR. Progress clean reps before band tension.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Hamstring Kickback
exercises.cue: Pelvis level; finish with glute, not low back

exercises.name: Dopa Band Side Bridge Pull Over
exercises.cue: Couple ribcage and pelvis; no lumbar collapse

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: ELASTIC POWER MECHANICS
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45 between rounds; stop when foot speed, jump height, landing, or posture declines.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Resistant Jump Squat
exercises.cue: Stick every landing; stop before height drops

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: MOBILITY ENGINE + GRIP ARMOR
deposits.effort: Rest 0:20 between rounds; RPE 6–7 with repeatable rhythm and smooth breathing.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Dynamic Bridge Stretch
exercises.home: Dopa Band dynamic bridge stretch for 40 sec

exercises.name: Dopa Band Wrist Waves
exercises.home: Dopa Band wrist waves for 40 sec
exercises.cue: Grip firm; shoulders relaxed; rhythm stays even

martialSupplement.name: Knee-Shield Recovery
martialSupplement.home: Dummy + mat: alternating knee-shield recovery to underhook position
martialSupplement.away: Clear floor: controlled solo recovery pattern
martialSupplement.cue: Protect the elbow; recover inside position deliberately
martialSupplement.text: Separate—not counted toward the physical workout or completion.
